rights: Original AI-generated concepts; project approved reference art and owner screenshot used as visual guidance. External RPG pages used only for structural design analysis, no sampled/traced/shipped game assets.
owner_appearance: Both directions accepted; owner then fixed combat scope to 10 active and about 20 passive talents. Skill catalog and tuning are separate gameplay brief, image text is illustrative.

files.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished 16:9 full-screen fantasy RPG hero development UI concept for the original game, using the attached approved profession screen ONLY as material/style/global-navigation reference. Opaque warm pearl ceramic background, plum enamel top bar, thin shaped silver frames, painted skill icons, restrained turquoise selection. Preserve global navigation Russian labels «Инвентарь I», «Исследования P», «Развитие героя O», «Карта M», «Esc · Закрыть» and compact resource wallet. No HH:MM clock. Heading «Развитие героя». Three clear inner tabs «Бой», «Добыча», «Авантюрист», Бой selected. Left 20 percent: compact hero level/XP, «Очки героя: 4», subsection choices «Оружие», «Магия и перемещение», «Выживание», no giant portrait. Center 52 percent: readable branching RPG skill tree, 12 generous illustrated nodes in 4 tiers, short clean prerequisite links, two active-spell shaped medallions and ten smaller passive nodes. Purchased, available, selected cyan, locked states visibly different. Skills based on bow, wand, precision, tempo, mana, mobility and survival; no swords/shields. Right 28 percent: fixed selected-skill detail «Точный удар», current→next effect, level prerequisite, explicitly «Очки героя», one «Изучить · 1 очко» button. Show progression purpose for level100 through meaningful branches, not a dense galaxy web. Include one small inset at bottom showing replacement O dock icon at large and actual small size: elegant rising stem splitting into three bright skill nodes inside plum/silver medallion, no face/profile silhouette. Other nav icons unchanged. No item rarity F–SSS frames, no fake extra currencies. Footer «Эскиз: состав и числа предварительные». Crisp Russian typography, clean spacing, game-ready material language, full page visible.
files.notes: Generated crit and branching-shot labels are not accepted runtime mechanics. Preserve existing damage passive semantics.

files.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished 16:9 four-panel UX approval board for original painted isometric fantasy RPG/tower defense game matching the attached actual screenshot's grass, tree, rocks, hero size and soft fantasy painting. Title «Полевой интерфейс · эскиз». Thin pearl/silver framing, plum typography and restrained cyan/gold accents. Four equal panels with short Russian captions. TOP LEFT «Квест на карте»: readable stylized world map with a distinct small cyan hero pointer, warm ivory thin direction arrow toward active camp parchment pin, and a compact round minimap inset with tiny rim arrow. Small completed quest comparison points to guild with check. Track ONE chosen quest, not every camp at once; no route line/autopath. TOP RIGHT «Попадание и HP»: original tusked green orc and matte purple ogre at realistic game scale with compact thin ruby HP bars overhead (no MP for these melee enemies), small floating ivory damage numbers e.g. 8 and 12, subtle local ivory hit spark and no gore, no dramatic lighting. Tiny isolated UI swatch below caption «MP — только если есть мана»: HP and thinner cyan MP bar only, no new enemy. BOTTOM LEFT «Добыча»: original hero axe/tree contact, a few tiny wood chips, floating compact «+3» with wood-log icon; beside it pickaxe on ordinary rock, restrained stone dust/chips and «+2» plus stone icon; metal pickup example «+1» with metal icon and very brief spark. No fake damage to resource, no duplicate arbitrary numbers. BOTTOM RIGHT «Читаемость в игре»: clean actual-scale woodland skirmish with tiny health bars and sparse small damage figures; narrow separate harvest yield example, one small offscreen quest pointer near minimap. Preserve scene simplicity. Do not redesign main HUD, no oversized text over units, no glowing outlines, no screen shake, no blood. All displayed values illustrative. Crisp Russian captions and generous spacing. This is appearance concept, not game screenshot.
files.notes: Runtime preserves actual hero bow and exact enemy artwork; no copied axe combat, world-map terrain or river from illustration.
